# TraceMigo

> Interactive Python code-comprehension and variable tracing platform.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://mostlyoutlier.pages.dev/
> Live Site: https://tracemigo.pages.dev/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/TraceMigo

## Overview
TraceMigo moves programming education beyond surface-level syntax and multiple-choice guessing. It provides an interactive pedagogical environment where developers read authentic Python code, commit to predictions, trace mutable state line-by-line, and explain the underlying runtime causality.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.dev/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Curavex, Hajree, Scanlark

## Core Learning Loop
1. **Predict**: Formulate a hypothesis of terminal variables and program output before execution.
2. **Trace**: Step through statements line-by-line with dynamic variable inspection, scope inspection, and call stack visualization.
3. **Explain**: Articulate why specific state mutations occurred against structured evaluation rubrics.
